# tagging interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:taggingInterval`](gmeow-taggingInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/taggingInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/tags`](../../slices/tags.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The time interval over which the tagging act holds. A relator carries its period this way (matching [`gmeow:usageInterval`](gmeow-usageInterval.md), [`gmeow:relationshipInterval`](gmeow-relationshipInterval.md)) rather than via RDF-star annotations on the relator node.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Tagging`](../classes/gmeow-Tagging.md) -> [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:taggingInterval`](gmeow-taggingInterval.md) from [`gmeow:Tagging`](../classes/gmeow-Tagging.md) to [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Tagging`](../classes/gmeow-Tagging.md), [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to time-scope a reified [`gmeow:Tagging`](../classes/gmeow-Tagging.md) — the period over which the tag was held to apply, when validity has a beginning or end.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the flat case, where period rides as RDF-star gmeow:validFrom/validUntil annotations on [`gmeow:hasTag`](gmeow-hasTag.md); reserve this for the relator form that carries its interval as a first-class node.

### How to use

- Point this role at a [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) on the [`Tagging`](../classes/gmeow-Tagging.md) node, matching the [`gmeow:usageInterval`](gmeow-usageInterval.md) / [`gmeow:relationshipInterval`](gmeow-relationshipInterval.md) idiom; to retract a tag without deleting it, set [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false on the relator instead of editing the interval.
